recognize_zh: 淋巴結 H&E 觸片中，有核細胞以大型、細胞質豐富粉紅色的細胞為主，細胞核卵圓或腎形偏心、染色質細緻，混有較小的淋巴球與帶雙葉核的嗜酸性球，背景大量紅血球，符合蘭格漢斯細胞組織球增生症。
features: Predominance of large cells with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm and well-defined borders
Oval to reniform, often eccentric nuclei with fine chromatin and small nucleoli; occasional nuclear folds
Admixed smaller lymphocytes with dark round nuclei, occasional neutrophils and bilobed eosinophils
describe_en: H&E-stained touch preparation of the lymph node shows numerous large cells with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm and oval to reniform nuclei with fine chromatin, some showing folds, predominating among the nucleated cells. Smaller lymphocytes, occasional neutrophils and eosinophils with bilobed nuclei are admixed in a background of abundant red blood cells. There is no significant nuclear pleomorphism or mitotic activity evident. Findings are consistent with Langerhans cell histiocytosis in conjunction with the tissue section and CD1a/langerin immunostains.

ddx.vs: Plasma cells have eccentric round nuclei with clock-face chromatin and basophilic cytoplasm with a perinuclear hof, rather than grooved nuclei in pink cytoplasm with eosinophils.
RDD histiocytes are much larger with emperipolesis and are CD1a negative.
Carcinoma forms cohesive clusters with nuclear pleomorphism and prominent nucleoli and is keratin positive.
